site.name: febrianthomas
site.description: Portfolio, illustrations, and notes by Febrian Thomas.

sections.title: Who Am I?
sections.description: Hi, I’m Febrian! I’m a self-taught illustrator and 2D animator who’s also learning web development. I might be quiet at first, but I enjoy sharing my creations and getting to know the people around me.

sections.title: What I Do.
sections.description: I create fan art and original characters, then bring some of them to life through 2D animation. I also experiment with websites and occasionally share videos on YouTube—when I remember to upload.

sections.title: What I Like.
sections.description: Give me anime, animation, drawing, video games, and a good cup of coffee. Actually, make that a lot of coffee.
sections.imageAlt: Illustration of a character with raised hands

sections.title: What Inspires Me.
sections.description: I love drawing and want to keep making better art and animation. Creators like GingerPale inspire me with the way they bring stories to life through animation.
sections.imageAlt: Illustration of a character with raised hands

about.title: About.
about.description: Hi, I’m Febrian—a self-taught illustrator and 2D animator who loves bringing characters and ideas to life.
about.details: When I’m not drawing or learning web development, you’ll probably find me watching anime, playing games, or enjoying another cup of coffee.
